subject: BASED clause
notes: cite.py --check 13.18.5.4 'The BASED clause specifies that the subject of the entry is a based entry defining a template that is dynamically associated with storage through an implicit data-address pointer.' -> OK §13.18.5.4 1). A BASED root has no storage of its own: ForceStringCanonical makes its class a cell-backed template, EmitPointerBackings emits the implicit ManagedPointer field + a deref bridge property, and every reference goes through CobolPtr.Deref(addrField,width).
